No regression; trunnions read as metal, lens element reads.
Ring carries the AXIS wordmark plate; reads best from the under/axial view (grazing in the hero).

important_features.note: Green emissive dot reads on the ring (intensity is the lighting-pass dial).

defects: WORDMARK ORIENTATION (minor, must-fix before P6): the string reads 'AXIS' correctly and is placed correctly (tangential plate, off the gasket), but the LETTERS run bottom-to-top — rotated ~90deg from upright, so a viewer would tilt their head to read it. This is exactly the orientation the builder flagged he cannot verify headless (no canvas under node, so the artwork never rasterises and letter rotation is unreadable). Verified by an orchestrator crop of the under view. Fix is the one rotate() in decals.mjs the builder offered; re-capture to confirm 'AXIS' reads upright along its baseline.
corrections: Apply the single rotate() so 'AXIS' reads upright (left-to-right along the plate baseline), and re-capture the under view to confirm.
Lighting-camera pass owns the status-LED emissive intensity.

mechanical.notes: 8/8 suites. Console clean. This pass is DELIBERATELY THIN and correctly so: it draws exactly ONE string, 'AXIS' — the OUI AC:CC:8E is registered to Axis Communications AB and is the only thing actually known about this device. NO model number (a single OUI spans the whole line, so nothing identifies this as an M3085-V; silkscreening a catalogue number over a declared dimensional surrogate would turn a labelled approximation into a fabricated identity), no resolution, no IP/IK rating, no PoE class, no series, no QR, no numerals — P1 records none. The Stratix earned a livery + six LED labels because its manual documents them; this asset has one defensible string and gets one. THREE defects fixed: (1) the brand crossed the rubber gasket -> moved to a tangential plate off the seal. (2) a spec note on axis_wordmark said it would appear declared-not-instantiated in a sweep and that was not drift — after the sweep was upgraded to walk material ARRAYS and match clones by id prefix, it DOES find it, so the note would now excuse REAL drift; corrected in place (an expired exemption is worse than no note). (3) the traceability sweep had stopped seeing per-face-material meshes (o.material.name is undefined on a 6-material mesh), masked by a hardcoded exception for axis_wordmark — now walks arrays, matches by prefix, exception DELETED (an exception is where real drift hides). Guard verifyNoWrapAroundTextures (the Stratix red-thread) fires exactly once on a reintroduced defect, zero as built. Right-sized by measurement both ways (canvas 144x512 -> 1.55x worst case; the next size down would interpolate letters UP in the near-axial state). Art rasterises once (memoised), no http/fetch/Image in the factory. Framing 43/43, lighting 1.715/0.094, contrast >=20% Weber, nothing floats — all unchanged.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. The surface pass is a model of restraint: it draws the ONE string the evidence defends ('AXIS', the OUI manufacturer) and refuses model numbers, ratings, and every numeral P1 does not carry — the same discipline that kept ratings off the Stratix and numbers off the UPS display, applied to a subject whose honest surface is nearly bare. The three defects (brand over a gasket, a spec note gone false, an exception masking a per-face-material blind spot) are all real and well-fixed. One minor must-fix before P6: the AXIS letters read rotated ~90deg (sideways) — I verified it in a crop since the builder correctly flagged he cannot rasterise the artwork headless; the fix is his offered one rotate(). Cleared to the lighting-camera pass; the wordmark rotation can ride alongside it, confirmed by a re-capture, before P6.
